title.en: Oshi (Uso) no Hittou Majutsu-shi-sama ga "Oretachi, Ryou Omoi Dattan da ne" to Dekiai Shitekurun desu ga?!

altTitles.ja: 推し（噓）の筆頭魔術師様が「俺たち、両思いだったんだね」と溺愛してくるんですが！？
推し(嘘)の筆頭魔術師様が「俺たち、両思いだったんだね」と溺愛してくるんですが!?

altTitles.ja-ro: Oshi (Uso) no Hittou Majutsushi-sama ga "Oretachi, Ryou Omoi Dattan da ne" to Dekiai Shitekurun desu ga!?

altTitles.en: A Lie May One Day Become the Truth!
The Magician I Am a Fan of (That's a Lie) Is Doting on Me and Saying "So We Were Both in Love with Each Other?"

description.en:
Born into a poor baron family, she had only one goal—to marry a wealthy man and save her sick younger brother. To achieve this, she decided to blend into noble society and avoid standing out.

In a world where “fan clubs” were a popular trend among nobles, she followed suit and falsely claimed to be a devoted admirer of the Grand Sorcerer of the Kingdom, despite having no real interest in him.

But then, something completely unexpected happened—the Grand Sorcerer himself proposed to her!

And the strangest part? He had known from the very beginning that she didn’t truly love him… yet he insisted on marrying her anyway!

Thus begins a complicated game of pretense, unexpected emotions, and an overwhelming love that can’t be avoided!

A romantic comedy filled with misunderstandings and hilarious situations, where one small lie leads to an unexpectedly real marriage!
description.ja:
愛が重すぎるイケメン筆頭魔術師と好きなフリを続けると誓った貧乏令嬢による溺愛＆すれ違いラブコメディ！

貧乏男爵家の末娘であるエルナは、病気を抱える弟の治療費のために、玉の輿に乗ることだけを考えて生きてきた。そのためには周りから浮いてはマズいと、社交界で大ブーム中の「ファンクラブ」文化にも乗って、王国筆頭魔術師であるスレンを推しているフリをしていたのだが、そのスレン当人から突然求婚されてしまって！？しかもスレンは、エルナが自分を好いてはいないと最初からわかっていたようで……。
